This Agenda contains a brief general description of each item to be considered. Copies of the Staff reports or
 other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the Agenda are on file in the Office
 of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. Any person who has a question concerning any of the
 agenda items may call the City Manager at (310) 603-0220, ext. 200.

  Procedures for Addressing the Council

 IN ORDER TO EXPEDITE CITY COUNCIL BUSINESS, WE ASK THAT ALL PERSONS WISHING TO
 ADDRESS  THE  COUNCIL  SUBMIT  YOUR  COMMENTS  IN  ADVANCE  TO
 CITYCLERK@LYNWOODCA.GOV OR FILL OUT A FORM PROVIDED AT THE PODIUM, AND TO TURN IT
 IN TO THE CITY CLERK PRIOR TO THE START OF THE MEETING. FAILURE TO FILL OUT SUCH A
 FORM WILL PROHIBIT YOU FROM ADDRESSING THE COUNCIL IN THE ABSENCE OF THE
 UNANIMOUS CONSENT OF THE COUNCIL.

 THIS PORTION PROVIDES AN OPPORTUNITY FOR THE PUBLIC TO ADDRESS THE
 COUNCIL ON ITEMS WITHIN THE JURISDICTION OF THE COUNCIL AND NOT LISTED

 SUBSTANTIAL DISCUSSION OF THE ISSUE BY THE COUNCIL, BUT COUNCIL MAY
 REFER THE MATTER TO STAFF OR SCHEDULE SUBSTANTIVE DISCUSSION FOR A
 FUTURE MEETING. (The Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54954.2 (a).)

 8. CONSENT CALENDAR
 ALL MATTERS LISTED UNDER THE CONSENT CALENDAR WILL BE ACTED UPON BY
 ONE MOTION AFFIRMING THE ACTION RECOMMENDED ON THE AGENDA. THERE
 WILL BE NO SEPARATE DISCUSSION ON THESE ITEMS PRIOR TO VOTING UNLESS

 FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR SEPARATE ACTION.

  M400B2 Base Station and qualified team of AMI labor, material and equipment required
  to complete connection of AMI Base Station and Antenna at 11108 N. Alameda St.
  Lynwood, CA 90262. (PW)

 Recommendation:

 Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the attached resolution entitled: “RESOLUTION
 OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LYNWOOD AWARDING A CONTRACT TO
 AQUA-METRICS SALES COMPANY FOR THE INSTALLATION OF ADVANCED METER
 INFRASTRUCTURE (AMI) ANTENNA, CIP PROJECT 4011.67.070 FOR A TOTAL NOT TO
 EXCEED AMOUNT OF $91,831.04.”

 Background:

 The City’s Advanced Meter Infrastructure (AMI) project is a multi-phased and multi-year
 project with the goal of replacing the City’s older positive displacement read water meters with
 new “smart” water meters and installation of two centrally located antennas for enhanced data
 communication. Once the AMI system is fully integrated and installed, the smart water meters
 will use the Sensus FlexNet M400B2 Base Station and Antenna to send water usage data
 directly to a cloud-based software platform. The data will be used to prepare bi-monthly water
 bills and analyze water demand. Installation of Sensus FlexNet M400B2 Base Station is
 necessary to communicate with AMI Smart water meters located citywide.

 Discussion and Analysis:

 The City of Lynwood, currently employs various water meters across its distribution system to
 track water usage for bi-monthly billing. Many of these meters, particularly positive
 displacement read meters, lose accuracy over time and require replacement every 15 to 20

  years. With over half of the City’s water meters installed before 2006, the meters need to be
 replaced as the City is transitioning to Sensus smart meters for improved accuracy and
 efficiency.

 Transitioning to an AMI involves installing smart meters that communicate water consumption
 data wirelessly to a cloud-based software platform. The new AMI system eliminates the need
 for manual meter reading, streamlines the billing processes, allows for proactive leak detection
 with customers and provides insight into consumption patterns to aid in conservation efforts

 The AMI system requires installation of new two (2) radio transmitters, strategically placed at
 specific locations: 4275 Walnut Avenue and 11108 North Alameda Street. These two (2)
 locations were identified by a propagation study to ensure comprehensive coverage. This
 setup, along with associated hardware and analytics, forms the data collection system.

 In addition, the purchase and installation of the second Sensus FlexNet M400 Base Station at
 11108 North Alameda Street, is needed in order to proceed with the AMI implementation. This
 step is crucial for integrating the new system into the city's infrastructure.

 Aqua-Metric Sales Co. Inc. of Riverside, California is the sole factory authorized
 representative for Sensus Metering Systems, Inc. products and services in Southern
 California. Because Aqua-Metric Sales Company is the only Southern California vendor
 available, Staff has selected to sole source the purchase of the equipment. The Lynwood
 Municipal Code (LMC) Section 6-3.12(a)(3) allows for an exception to competitive bidding of
 any kind when supplies, equipment, services or contract could only be obtained from only one
 source.

 Approval to award Aqua-Metric Sales Company for a total not to exceed amount of $91,831.04
 is needed. In accordance with the City's purchasing policy, City Council approval is necessary.
